_meta.descricao: He beat a Grandmaster at 11. He became a FIDE Master at 12. Mathias Casalaspro is training for the International Master title — and you can be part of it.

hero.selo: August 2026 · First IM norm achieved in Portugal
hero.h1: FIDE Master at 12. International Master is the next step.
hero.lede: In August 2026, at the Leça Chess Open, Mathias Casalaspro finished 5th overall — level on points with the winner, with a 2553 performance — and secured his first International Master norm. Two norms and 59 rating points to go.

numeros.h2: A career that began at the age of 7
historia.legenda: Torneo Internacional Cidade de Pontevedra · Spain, 4–11 July 2026
historia.p1: I learned to move the pieces at 7. Four months later, I played my first official tournament.
historia.p2: At 9, I beat my first Grandmaster in a simul. At 11, I beat a GM in an official classical game — the youngest Brazilian ever to do it. At 12, I became a FIDE Master.
historia.p3: In Portugal, at the Leça Chess Open, I finished level on points with the winner, with a 2553 performance, and secured my first International Master norm.
historia.p4: There is no luck in chess. There is study, discipline and opportunity.
destaque.h3: 5th overall, a 2553 performance and the first IM norm
destaque.p: At the Leça Chess Open in Portugal, Mathias finished level on points with the winner and placed 5th only on tiebreak — among 20 federations, facing four Grandmasters. That result secured his first International Master norm. He also took the trophy for first place in the Under-14 category.

glossario.titulo: For those who don't play chess
glossario.gm:
Grandmaster (GM)
The highest title in chess. There are around 1,900 in the world. In Brazil, only 15 — and not all of them still active.
glossario.fm:
FIDE Master (FM)
FIDE's first international title. Mathias earned it at 12.
glossario.rating:
Rating
A measure of a player's strength. 2000 is a good player, 2200 an excellent one, 2400 allows the International Master title, and above 2500 opens the way to Grandmaster.
glossario.norma:
Norm
A high-level result in an international tournament against titled players. Becoming an IM or GM takes three of them, plus the minimum rating.
caminho.h2:
To keep moving forward, he needs opportunity and investment.
And you can help.
caminho.p: To become an International Master you need to reach 2400 FIDE rating and earn 3 IM norms: high-level results in tournaments with titled players from different federations. He already has the talent and the training. What is missing is being seated at the right boards, and that costs money.
normas.txt: IM norms. The first came in Leça, Portugal, in August 2026. Two to go — and each one requires a tournament with titled players from at least three different federations. Few of those exist each year, and getting to them is precisely the part that doesn't depend on talent.
